title: Decision Reviews and Appeals Lane Matrix: Sequencing, Continuity and Further Appeal
content:
**Decision Reviews and Appeals — training matrix on lane sequencing, continuity and further appeal**

The matrix records, for each of the six lanes, the terms that govern how one review relates to the decision before it and to the review that may follow it.

| Lane | Continuous pursuit period after a review decision (calendar days) | Continuous pursuit preserves the effective date of the original claim | May be chosen again for a decision issued in this same lane on the same issue | May be chosen to review a Board decision | Each issue of a decision may be placed in a different lane | One issue may be pending in two lanes at once | Period to appeal a Board decision to the Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Supplemental Claim | 365 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | 0 |
| Higher-Level Review | 365 | Yes | No | No | Yes | No | 0 |
| Higher-Level Review with Informal Conference | 365 | Yes | No | No | Yes | No | 0 |
| Board Appeal - Direct Review Docket | 365 | Yes | No | No | Yes | No | 120 |
| Board Appeal - Evidence Submission Docket | 365 | Yes | No | No | Yes | No | 120 |
| Board Appeal - Hearing Docket | 365 | Yes | No | No | Yes | No | 120 |

**Column notes**

1. *Continuous pursuit period.* The number of calendar days after a review decision within which filing the next lane keeps the original effective date: 365 in every lane, and in every lane continuous pursuit preserves the effective date of the original claim.
2. *Same lane again.* Only the Supplemental Claim lane may be chosen again for a decision issued in the Supplemental Claim lane on the same issue. Neither Higher-Level Review lane and none of the Board dockets may be chosen for a decision issued in that same lane on the same issue.
3. *After a Board decision.* Only the Supplemental Claim lane may be chosen to review a Board decision.
4. *Issues and lanes.* Each issue in a decision may be placed in a different lane, in every lane; and in no lane may one issue be pending in two lanes at once.
5. *Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims.* A Board decision may be appealed to the Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims within 120 calendar days; the figure is 0 for the three regional office lanes.

**Matrix exercises (hypothetical)**

- A decision issued in the Supplemental Claim lane on one issue: the matrix shows the Supplemental Claim lane may be chosen again for it.
- A decision issued on the Board Appeal - Direct Review Docket: of the six lanes, the matrix marks only the Supplemental Claim lane as one that may be chosen to review a Board decision, and the Court period of 120 calendar days applies to that Board decision.
- A decision covering three issues: each of the three issues may be placed in its own lane, but no single issue may be pending in two lanes at the same time.
